dataQuality.representativeMetrics: 2026.01-07 canonical representative = smallest parsable 小类BSR; tie-break by complete sales/revenue fields, then source row; child rows are never summed
dataQuality.ranking: 2026.01-07 category tiers use the best parsable 小类BSR among qualifying variants in the same parent family
dataQuality.top100Cap: each category/month is deterministically capped at 100 listings; all tier tables reuse that exact Top100 pool
dataQuality.historicalBsrWarning: 2022-2025 exports do not contain listing identifiers; BSR Top100 is a deterministic row proxy, not 100 provably independent listings. Cross-year BSR changes are directional only.

definitions.pp: 标题按不区分大小写的完整单词 plastic（单词边界）筛选；2026父体任一变体命中即归PP，空标题按空字符串
definitions.high: 排除 PP 父体后的全部商品（SPEC 7.5：其余全部归入高客单非PP，不再叠加材质关键词或价格门槛）
definitions.bsrTop100: 2022-2025: deterministic row proxy because ASIN/父ASIN are absent; 2026: independent parent/ASIN listings using the minimum numeric 小类BSR among qualifying variants; cap at 100
definitions.bsrGroups: head = 1-20, middle = 21-50, tail = 51-100; groups do not overlap
definitions.avgListPrice: simple average of non-null, non-blank, numeric SKU list prices; missing prices are excluded rather than treated as zero
definitions.momMonthly: 月度MOM/环比（最新用户口径）：今年X月 vs 去年X月同月（跨年同月）
definitions.annualYoY: 年度同周期数值对比；2026.01-06 vs 2025.01-06 因统计单元从行级变为父体级，仅作方向性参考，不是严格同口径同比

annual.scopeNote: 方向性参考：时间同周期，但2025为无ASIN的行级导出（含变体行），2026为父ASIN去重快照；统计单元不同，不构成严格同口径同比
